HELLOSPIRE-AURA_OF_VITALITY.title: Aura of Vitality
HELLOSPIRE-AURA_OF_VITALITY.description: At the start of your turn, all allies heal {AuraOfVitalityPower:diff()} HP.
HELLOSPIRE-LIGHT_OF_DAWN.title: Light of Dawn
HELLOSPIRE-LIGHT_OF_DAWN.description:
Heal all allies HP equal to half your [gold]Faith[/gold] in [gold]Ilmater[/gold].
[gold]Blessed[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-REDEMPTION.title: Redemption
HELLOSPIRE-REDEMPTION.description:
Requires 5 [gold]Faith[/gold] in [gold]Ilmater[/gold].
Revive all downed allies at 1 HP.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-THE_BROKEN_GOD.title: The Broken God
HELLOSPIRE-THE_BROKEN_GOD.description: At the start of your turn, all allies heal HP equal to half your [gold]Faith[/gold] in [gold]Ilmater[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-DIVINE_SMITE.title: Divine Smite
HELLOSPIRE-DIVINE_SMITE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have 3 or more [gold]Faith[/gold] in any deity, deal {Bonus:diff()} additional damage.
Apply {JudgedPower:diff()} [gold]Judged[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-HAMMER_OF_WRATH.title: Hammer of Wrath
HELLOSPIRE-HAMMER_OF_WRATH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the enemy is below half HP, deal {Bonus:diff()} additional damage and gain 2 [gold]Faith[/gold] in [gold]Tyr[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-VOW_OF_ENMITY.title: Vow of Enmity
HELLOSPIRE-VOW_OF_ENMITY.description: Choose an enemy. Your Attacks against it deal {VowOfEnmityPower:diff()} additional damage.
HELLOSPIRE-EYE_FOR_AN_EYE.title: Eye for an Eye
HELLOSPIRE-EYE_FOR_AN_EYE.description: Whenever an enemy attacks you, deal that much damage back to it.
HELLOSPIRE-DIVINE_STORM.title: Divine Storm
HELLOSPIRE-DIVINE_STORM.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Heal {Heal:diff()} HP for each enemy hit.
HELLOSPIRE-FINAL_RECKONING.title: Final Reckoning
HELLOSPIRE-FINAL_RECKONING.description: Deal damage to ALL enemies equal to your total [gold]Faith[/gold] across every deity.
HELLOSPIRE-HERESY.title: Heresy
HELLOSPIRE-HERESY.description: Your [gold]Faith[/gold] in every deity counts as your highest.
HELLOSPIRE-ZEALOTRY.title: Zealotry
HELLOSPIRE-AVENGING_WRATH.title: Avenging Wrath
HELLOSPIRE-AVENGING_WRATH.description:
Requires 4 [gold]Faith[/gold] in [gold]Tyr[/gold].
For {AvengingWrathPower:diff()} turns, your Attacks deal 5 additional damage.
HELLOSPIRE-TIME_OF_TROUBLES.title: Time of Troubles
HELLOSPIRE-TIME_OF_TROUBLES.description:
Spend ALL your [gold]Faith[/gold] in [gold]Torm[/gold].
Deal double that damage. Gain that much [gold]Faith[/gold] in [gold]Bane[/gold].
HELLOSPIRE-TYRANNY.title: Tyranny
HELLOSPIRE-TYRANNY.description:
Requires 5 [gold]Faith[/gold] in [gold]Bane[/gold].
Your [gold]Faith[/gold] in [gold]Bane[/gold] counts as [gold]Faith[/gold] in every deity.
